source_row.rationale: Providing non-slip footwear (such as textured-sole socks or slippers) rather than allowing ambulation in regular socks or barefoot is intended to improve traction on hospital flooring and reduce slip-related fall risk, a simple but evidence-supported component of comprehensive fall prevention practice for hospitalized clients.
